# Agentic NetOps - Public Documentation

A multi-agent platform that diagnoses, validates, and gates every proposed
network change against your policies, your blast radius, and a digital
twin - before a human even sees the approval.

**Customer-facing docs site:** https://eduardd76.github.io/dream_team_public

**Browsable wiki (auto-generated):** https://deepwiki.com/eduardd76/dream_team_public

**Implementation status:** workshop preview  paid pilots from 2026-Q3

## What's in this repo

This repository contains the public documentation for the platform -
architecture, demo scripts, ROI math, technical depth for engineers, and
the scalability story for chief architects. The implementation code lives
in a private repository; pilot customers receive access on engagement.
